title: City Council Regular Session Meeting 9/15/2026
agendaText: City Council Regular Session Meeting - September 15, 2026 Agenda Full Package Agenda Full Package Open Video in new Window Video City Council Agenda Campbell Police Department EOC 100 N. First Street, Campbell, California ATTENTION: This meeting is being held at an alternate location and will not be conducted in the City Hall Council Chambers. Please see meeting location above. Location map will be provided on the City's website Agenda Center with the posting of this agenda. This City Council Regular meeting will be conducted in person as well as telecommunication and is compliant with provisions of the Brown Act. The City Council meeting will be live-streamed on Channel 26 (Xfinity) or Channel 88 (Direct TV), the City's website and on YouTube https://www.youtube.com/user/CityofCampbell for those who only wish to view the meeting. Those members of the public wishing to provide public comment virtually are asked to register in advance at: https://www.campbellca.gov/signup . After registering, you will receive a confirmation email containing information about joining the meeting. Members of the public may attend the meeting in person at Campbell City Hall - Council Chambers. Public comment will also be accepted via email at [email protected] until 12:00 p.m. prior to the start of the meeting. Written comments will be posted on the website and distributed to the Council. If you choose to email your comments, please indicate in the subject line “FOR PUBLIC COMMENT” and indicate the item number. REGULAR MEETING OF THE CAMPBELL CITY COUNCIL Tuesday, September 15, 2026 07:00 PM City Hall Council Chamber 1. CALL TO ORDER/ROLL CALL 2. PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE 3. SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS Please Note: Items listed under Special Presentations and Proclamations are considered ceremonial. The City Council will not take action on these matters. 4. COMMUNICATIONS AND PETITIONS 5. ORAL REQUESTS NOTE: This portion of the meeting is reserved for persons wishing to address the City Council on any matter not on the agenda. Persons wishing to address the Council are requested, but not required to complete a Speaker’s Card. Speakers are limited to two (2) minutes. The law generally prohibits the Council from discussion or taking action on such items. However, the Council may instruct staff accordingly regarding Oral Requests. 6. COUNCIL ANNOUNCEMENTS 7. CONSENT CALENDAR NOTE: All matters listed under consent calendar are considered by the City Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion. There will be no separate discussion of these items unless a request is made by a member of City Council, City staff, or a member of the public. Any person wishing to speak on any item on the consent calendar should ask to have the item removed from the consent calendar prior to the time the Council votes to approve. If removed, the item will be discussed in the order in which it appears. 7.1 Minutes of City Council Special Meeting of September 1, 2026. Recommended Action Approve the special meeting minutes of September 1, 2026. 7.2 Minutes of City Council Regular Meeting of September 1, 2026. Recommended Action Approve the regular meeting minutes of September 1, 2026. 7.3 Approving Payment of Bills and Claims Recommended Action Approve the bills and claims in the amount of $1,177,106.86. 7.4 Resolution Approving the Revised Agreement with Trio Community Meals, LLC to Provide Catered Meals for the Senior Nutrition Program for Fiscal Year 2026-27 (Resolution/Roll Call Vote) Recommended Action That the City Council adopt a Resolution approving the revised Seventh Amendment to the Agreement with Trio Community Meals, LLC to correct the meal rate for the Senior Nutrition Program for Fiscal Year 2026-27 and authorize the City Manager to execute the Amendment. 7.5 Approval of Memorandum of Understanding between City of Campbell and Campbell Police Civilian Employees Association (Resolution/Roll Call Vote) Recommended Action That the City Council adopt a resolution ratifying a successor Memorandum of Understanding, effective July 1, 2026 through June 30, 2028, between the City of Campbell and the Campbell Police Civilian Employees Association (CPCEA). 7.6 Water Tower Lighting Request - El Camino Health Recommended Action That the City Council approve El Camino Health’s Water Tower themed lighting request application and direct staff to illuminate the City of Campbell Water Tower pink on October 6, 2026, in recognition of Breast Cancer Awareness Month and to raise awareness of breast cancer. 8. PUBLIC HEARINGS AND INTRODUCTIONS OF ORDINANCES NOTE: Members of the public may be allotted up to two (2) minutes to comment on any public hearing item. Applicants/Appellants and their representatives may be allotted up to a total of five (5) minutes for opening statements and up to a total of three (3) minutes maximum for closing statements. Items requested/recommended for continuance are subject to Council’s consent at the meeting. 8.1 Public Hearing to Consider Adoption of an Ordinance Extending Interim Ordinance No. 26-2354, which Continues implementation of Senate Bill (SB) 450 (2024), as Modified by Assembly Bill (AB) 1061 (2025) (Ordinance/ 4/5 Roll Call Vote). Recommended Action It is recommended that the City Council adopt the attached ordinance to extend Interim Ordinance No. 26-2354, for a period for 10 months and 15 days. 9. NEW BUSINESS 9.1 Annual Investment Policy Update FY (2026-27) (Resolution/Roll Call Vote) Recommended Action It is recommended that the City Council adopt a Resolution approving the annual update to the City’s Investment Policy for FY 2026-27. 9.2 Proposed Modifications to Council Policy, Section 14, Theatre Use Policy (Resolution/Roll Call Vote) Recommended Action That the City Council adopt a resolution approving the proposed modifications to Council Policy, Section 14, Theatre Use Policy, effective September 16, 2026. 9.3 Budget Adjustment to Fund Replacement Blackout Shades for the Heritage Theatre (Resolution/Roll Call Vote) Recommended Action That the City Council approve the Council Resolution authorizing a budget adjustment to fund the replacement of the remaining six blackout shades at the Heritage Theatre. 9.4 Accepting Funds from the Santa Clara County Library District for the Measure O – Campbell Library Renovations Project No. 23-SS (Resolution/Roll Call Vote) Recommended Action That the City Council adopt a resolution accepting a $268,388.96 reimbursement from the Santa Clara County Library District for Measure O – Campbell Library Renovations Project and authorizing the Finance Director to perform the associated budget adjustment. 9.5 Approval of Cost Share Agreement with the City of San Jose in the Not to Exceed Amount of $335,000 for the Resurfacing of McCoy Avenue and Olympia Avenue (Resolution/Roll Call Vote) Recommended Action That the City Council adopt a resolution 1) approving the cost share agreement with the City of San Jose in the not to exceed amount of $335,000 for the resurfacing of McCoy Avenue and Olympia Avenue; 2) authorizing the City Manager to execute said agreement; and 3) authorizing the Finance Director to perform associated budget adjustments. 9.6 Authorization to Execute Vehicle Registration Fee-Intelligent Transportation Systems (VRF-ITS) Fund Agreement for Campbell ITS Mobility and Safety Improvement Project (Resolution/Roll Call Vote) Recommended Action That the City Council adopt a resolution 1) approving the fund agreement with the Santa Clara Valley Transportation Authority (VTA) for the Campbell ITS Mobility & Safety Improvement Project; and 2) authorizing the City Manager to execute the fund agreement and any amendments thereof. 10. UNFINISHED BUSINESS 11. COUNCIL COMMITTEE REPORTS 11.1 Council Committee Reports Recommended Action That the City Council report on activities from their committee assignments. 12. ADJOURN IMPORTANT NOTICE: Materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the City Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection with the agenda packet in the lobby of City Clerk’s Office, 70 N. First Street, Campbell, CA 95008, during normal business hours. These materials will also be available on the City website at https://pub-campbell.escribemeetings.com with the agenda packet following the last item of the agenda, subject to staff’s ability to post the documents prior to the meeting. All documents not posted prior to the meeting will be posted the next business day. In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, listening assistive devices are available for all meetings held in the City Council Chambers. If you require accommodation, please contact the City Clerk’s Office, (408) 866-2117, at least one week in advance of the meeting.
